dedupe_keys.name: ontl transport cost simulator simulador de custo de transporte brazil

description: The transport cost simulator of Brazil's National Transport and Logistics Observatory (ONTL) is an online tool that calculates the costs of freight transport operations in Brazil. It compares road, rail and waterway transport, including inland waterways and coastal shipping, and organises the calculations by cargo group: solid agricultural bulk, non-agricultural solid bulk, liquid bulk, general cargo and containerised general cargo. Users can simulate logistics scenarios and compare modal alternatives, which the observatory presents as support for investment decisions, negotiations and public policy, including infrastructure planning and a shift to more sustainable modes. It is published on the ONTL portal. Coverage is national (Brazil). The simulator is free to use online; no licence is stated and the code is not published. Caveats: the page does not document the cost parameters in detail, and results are estimates for planning, not market prices. It supports economic appraisal of freight corridors, modal shift and investment appraisal, and cost inputs to freight network models. It complements the MIRACA flow allocation model and other freight models catalogued here.
